t: This is London Terrariums, a shop in London. It was founded and owned by Emma Sibley, a British horticulturist and author. Her background in plants is the reason the shop exists, so what you see here reflects her knowledge of growing things. She matters here as both the founder and the owner, which means the shop is closely tied to one person's expertise. I don't have more specifics about what is sold or how the shop began, so I'll keep this short and let the shop speak for itself.
